b: Spent a week of Claude limits rebuilding a trading grid I’ve had in my head for 15 years

About 15 years ago I worked with a derivatives trading team at one of the biggest investment banks in the world. The task sounds simple: a trader watches quotes, and positions update in real time, per client, per portfolio or for the whole bank.
Back then we had our own hand-written grid in C#, and now I’ve rebuilt the idea in Rust on gpui-kit. Here is the repo link.
In my benchmarks it’s 11x faster than the built-in DataTable in gpui-kit.
